At theta=±1 weight 1+theta t is positive a.e.; injectivity of Poisson spherical-harmonic moments for finite measures proves strict finite-site positivity and C(S^d) universality, not just L² positivity. On S² the zonal Legendre Jacobi block dominates all |m|>0 compressions, norm largest zero xi_(L+1); finite cutoff misses supercritical theta. The explicit r=1/4, epsilon=9/20 yields theta=9/8 and g=(1-t)^9 weighted normalized energy -1/80; 1-2epsilon=1/10>0.
